core.name: Malmö Opera
core.why: One of the Nordic region's largest opera houses, on Östra Rönneholmsvägen since 1944; the city's flagship stage.

core.name: Malmö Live Konserthus
core.why: The city's concert hall in the Malmö Live complex by the Central Station, home of Malmö SymfoniOrkester.

core.name: Malmö Stadsteater (Hipp)
core.why: The city theatre's main house, the Hippodromen circus building on Kalendegatan, known to everyone as Hipp.

core.name: Moriska Paviljongen
core.why: The seven-towered 1902 pavilion in Folkets park, a concert and club venue known as Moriskan.

core.name: Spegeln
core.why: Art-house cinema on Stortorget since 1934 (originally Alcazar), still running.

core.name: Royal
core.why: Filmstaden's big 1961 cinema at Södra Tullgatan/Triangeln, Malmö's largest screen.

core.name: Filmstaden Storgatan
core.why: The central multiplex on Storgatan since 1998, a common meeting point near Gustav Adolfs torg.

core.name: Victoriateatern
core.why: 1912 cinema turned theatre and music stage on Södra Förstadsgatan, still active.

core.name: Palladium
core.why: 1920 culture house on Södergatan between Stortorget and Gustav Adolfs torg, run as a concert venue by Musik i Syd.

core.name: Nöjesteatern
core.why: Revue and musical stage at Amiralsgatan by Folkets park, a 1940 cinema building.

core.name: Babel
core.why: Club and concert venue in a former church on Spångatan at Möllan.

core.name: Inkonst
core.why: Long-running club and performance venue on Bergsgatan, home of Intonal festival.

core.name: Pildammsteatern
core.why: The open-air stage in Pildammsparken used every summer since 1952.

core.name: Malmö konsthall
core.why: Major public art hall on S:t Johannesgatan since 1975, about 200,000 visitors a year.

core.name: Panora
core.why: Folkets Bio's art-house cinema at Möllan, active in 2026.

core.name: Etage
core.why: The multi-floor nightclub on Stortorget, running for about four decades.

core.name: Skånes Dansteater
core.why: The regional dance company's house at Dockan in Västra hamnen.

notes: Closed, so not added: Kulturbolaget/KB (Bergsgatan, closed Sept 2023; the stale OSM node/445847413 is still tagged nightclub and should not be used), Casino Cosmopol (Kungsparken, closed 24 Feb 2024), Debaser Malmö (left Folkets park 2013), old Malmö Konserthus (way/289662618, replaced by Malmö Live). Palladium had a lease dispute but still books concerts into 2026-27; recheck before shipping. Malmö konsthall is a gallery and should probably move to museums. Malmö Stadsteater's point is the Hipp building; the Wikidata item is in _unmatched (Q18244214), and way/417455554 Hippodromen gives the building outline. Malmö Arena (concerts, in game) and Folkets park (in game) are left to other categories. Mejeriet (Lund) lies outside the area. With so few long-list items, core is 17 + 2 missing = 19; Etage, Skånes Dansteater, Panora and Filmstaden Storgatan are the weakest core picks.
